gates.summary: P3.5 immutable generated-only package is accepted and P3.6 planning is explicitly authorized.
P3.6 planning vocabulary and ownership are aligned to the completed Phase -1 shared contract and deployment-profile baseline.
Exact official metadata planning is owner accepted for DET-E1/B1/A1, but no artifact is acquired, no H-CAM comparison evidence exists, and no champion/fallback pair is approved.

The portable_cpu planning proposal, inventory-admission A/A/A/A policies, portable-R1 U3B A/A/A/A policies, portable compatibility U3C A/A/A/A policies, and supply-chain U3D A/A/A/A/A policies are owner accepted as non-effective planning. R1 supplies only the inventory input; six other resolver inputs, all 22 evidence gaps, exact storage and scanner bindings, actual compatibility artifacts, generated evidence, other profiles, and profile activation remain unresolved.
D-P3.6-001 through D-P3.6-005 are accepted in the P3.6 owner decision record; A+ extensions remain subordinate to the fail-closed A baselines.

The digest-bound three-artifact R0 metadata proposal and U3D A/A/A/A/A supply-chain policies remain owner accepted as non-effective planning. U3E and U3G were each consumed and failed closed; both empty attempt-created roots were removed. U3F and U3H A/A/A/A/A/A choices are explicitly accepted. U3H authorizes preparation only of a reviewable runner proposal and a storage-only proposal; the Defender-only proposal remains sequenced after accepted storage evidence. No retry, F: or ACL action, Defender query/hash/trust check, runner implementation, ModelScan action, acquisition, or execution is authorized.
A D-P3.6-START statement was received on 2026-08-29 but is non-effective because G1, G2, and G4 are blocked and no exact digest-bound executable package exists.
